exact_artifact_findings: The V11 consent orchestrator was D1 schema-and-validator only; public users could not create a usable consent-minimized handoff.
public_user_journey_findings: Portal preparation existed, but continuity into another product required manual re-entry with no minimal fixed-choice handoff receipt.
professional_staff_owner_findings: Owner visibility showed capability maturity but not whether ordinary releases improved both owner-mandated tracks.
defects_and_friction: A schema-only orchestration capability could be mistaken for user value without a usable local workflow.
accessibility_privacy_security_data_find: Fixed selections can provide continuity without narrative, contact, document, health, financial, or authentication data.
deployment_and_operations_findings: No provider or deployment access is required for either improvement.
prior_release_and_deferral_findings: v1.7.75 explicitly deferred runtime transfer and selected only a D1 consent schema; V12 requires both product and builder-system progress.

creative_new_capability_candidates.reason: Converts the accepted consent contract into user value while preserving no-transfer architecture.
Makes V12's owner mission mechanically testable for every ordinary release.
Would require separate privacy, security, retention, identity, and owner authorization evidence.

product_platform_track.primary_objective: Create a usable device-only journey continuity workflow without transmitting or storing user information.

prompt_and_continuation_findings: Prior release evidence did not mechanically fail a release when only the product or builder track improved.
schema_and_test_findings: V12 templates require product and prompt improvement reports and cross-version learning, but product-level validation was absent.
automation_and_recovery_findings: A deterministic gate can validate both tracks without provider access.
evidence_and_reporting_findings: The gate must link each track to affected files, tests, benefits, limitations, and carried-forward lessons.
candidate_waves: Protected owner view and release test
